name: AICardAgentReasoning
description: AICardAgentReasoning is the canonical "what the agent is thinking" card for AI-led surfaces. The header carries the agent identity (avatar, name, AGENT chip, REASONING & ANALYSIS eyebrow) and a live-status pill. A white AI Summary panel renders a brief headline + a quoted longer analysis under a divider. In Simple density an Optimization Drivers panel appears below, listing each driver with its percentage contribution and a qualitative intensity chip (only High gets a tinted chip; Medium / Low render as plain labels). A footer pairs an Explainability toggle with a primary "Deepen Analysis" action. Use this card whenever you need to surface an agent's reasoning + decision drivers in a governable, scannable way — e.g. inside an Agent Drawer, on a generated dashboard, or above a workspace.
intent: Surface an agent's reasoning + optional optimization drivers behind an Explainability toggle.

keyboard: Ensure keyboard focus order matches visual order

usage: Surfacing an agent's reasoning behind a recommendation
Showing the weighted decision drivers when Explainability is on
Inside an AI Agent Drawer, a generated dashboard, or above an AI Led workspace
doNotUse: For an active conversation with the agent — use the AI Command Center Dialog group
For a list of insights without an agent identity — use AIInsightList
For a step-by-step trace of agent operations — use AIReasoningTrace
When the surface needs the full agent persona introduction (capabilities, talk script) — use AICardAgent
Do not invent dependency atomics — use bundled canonical sources
Do not hardcode brand hex — use AI tokens
Do not require an external AI UI package for agent implementations — use co-located TSX
